name: Expectation of Failure
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, lathspell 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a bit of rat fur)

EFFECT

Range 50 ft.
Target enemies within a 50-ft. burst centered on the caster
Duration 1 minute/level or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Each affected creature is filled with the potential for profound failure. If the creature is subject to a penalty from a fear or despair effect, the caster may discharge the spell to double the penalty on one roll made by the subject before the roll is made. Alternatively, the caster may discharge the spell to double the AC penalty (if applicable) against a single attack.
